test_cases.name: vague_self_idea
test_cases.input: I want an app for tracking my plants.
assertions: Does not emit a ready-to-paste brief
Asks who it is for and what goes wrong today
Asks for the primary action and an observable success signal
Asks what we are deliberately not doing

test_cases.name: client_solution_request
test_cases.input: Client wants a dashboard with AI insights.
assertions: Does not treat the dashboard as the requirement
Asks what decision or job the request supports
Asks what insight means in observable terms
Keeps the user need separate from the proposed solution

test_cases.name: long_prd_dump
test_cases.input: Here is the full PRD. It covers search, checkout, reviews, seller tools, notifications, and billing. Turn it into the build brief.
assertions: Names the slices in the PRD
Asks which slice to focus on
Does not import unrelated sections into scope

test_cases.name: missing_non_goals
test_cases.input: Shoppers abandon checkout because shipping cost appears on the last step. The primary user is the shopper. The PM approves it. We should show the shipping cost on the cart. Success is the shopper seeing the cost before payment. Write the brief.
assertions: Asks what we are deliberately not doing before the final brief
Does not invent exclusions

test_cases.name: ambiguous_quality_words
assertions: Does not copy seamless or intuitive into a requirement
Asks for a concrete success and failure
Uses an observable acceptance criterion only after the user answers

test_cases.name: usability_validation_prototype
test_cases.input: I want a prototype to test whether the new navigation is understandable.
assertions: Includes a prototype question and a task
Asks for or records success and failure signals
Includes relevant usability checks without designing the screens

test_cases.name: ai_agent_handoff
assertions: Does not write implementation code
After confirmation, the brief has an ordered build sequence
Includes acceptance criteria, accepted edge cases, and explicit unknowns

test_cases.name: premature_brief_request
test_cases.input: Just write the brief now. I want something for saving favorite searches.
assertions: Does not emit a Ready-to-paste brief on that request alone
Either asks the minimum missing questions or produces a draft labeled unconfirmed
Labels unknowns as assumptions or open questions and does not present them as confirmed
